summary: The failing `Vercel` check on PR #14 is a 45-minute Vercel build-duration ceiling, not a product defect, a broken project link, a missing preview env var, or a quota/plan/permission problem. However, read-only inspection proves the PR is wired to the PRODUCTION Vercel project: `tourify-beta-k2` = `prj_H9Dgawpmj2dAuwfcuuiy1O7kXS1n`, whose `targets.production.alias` still includes `demo.tourify.live`, and the Vercel Git integration is still building PR preview deployments inside it. That contradicts RELEASE-007 acceptance criterion 1 and docs/DEPLOYMENT_ROUTINE.md section 4. No hosted setting was changed; every item below needs owner authorization.
completed: Diagnosed the failure: GET /v13/deployments/dpl_2zPXya6iLnXhdgDPeHu7mX3cbQdY -> readyState ERROR, errorCode BUILD_EXCEEDED_MAXIMUM_TIME, plan pro, buildingAt->ready 2738.605s = 45.64 minutes.

Ruled out the four candidate causes with direct evidence: webpack compile succeeded ('Compiled successfully in 4.4min'); the GitHub project link resolves (link.type github, repo Tourify/KyleQD, productionBranch main, repoId 1166070718); `[env-check] Production build environment contract passed.` at 17:37:03.133 and the project env contains all six required variable NAMES; the build ran a full 45 minutes on the pro plan with no paywall or permission message.

Established that the controlled promotion path is immune to this ceiling: deploy-demo.yml line 105 runs `vercel build --prod` in GitHub Actions and line 115 runs `vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod`, which uploads an artifact and performs no Vercel-side build. Only the uncontrolled Git-triggered auto-preview path is bounded by 45 minutes.

Confirmed the wrong-project binding: GET /v9/projects/tourify-beta-k2 -> targets.production.alias = [tourify.live, demo.tourify.live, www.tourify.live, ...] and link.type = github with productionBranch main, so any PR branch auto-builds into the production project.

Recorded three configuration-drift items that were deliberately NOT changed: (1) the repo tracks BOTH package-lock.json (npm, lockfile v3) and a stale 332KB pnpm-lock.yaml, and the hosted build warned `Detected pnpm-lock.yaml 9 ... Using pnpm@10.x based on project creation date`; (2) the hosted project setting is nodeVersion `22.x` while engines.node is `24.x` and .nvmrc is `24`; (3) three declared heap ceilings for one workload - vercel.json build.env 4096, package.json build:vercel 6144, package.json typecheck 8192 - on a 4-core/8GB Vercel build machine.
